_note: Broad capability groups, not a fixed list. 'area' groups them on the home page. 'process': 'sourcing' uses site.sourcingProcess, otherwise site.process. No guarantees, statistics, clients or certifications.

services.title: Business & Sourcing
services.summary: Sourcing, research, coordination and practical business support, kept structured from the first brief to follow-up.
body: Some requirements are about finding the right product, supplier or partner. Others are about keeping several parties moving in the same direction. Both need the same things: a clear brief, careful research and someone who follows up.
We take the requirement, research the options, coordinate the people involved and report back with what is confirmed and what is still open, so decisions stay with you and the legwork stays with us.
audience: Businesses that need a product, material or supplier found and compared
Teams managing several external parties on one requirement
International partners working with businesses in Bangladesh, and the reverse
handle: Clarifying the requirement: specification, quantity, standard and timeline
Researching markets and identifying suitable suppliers or partners
Requesting and organising quotations, samples and information
Coordinating communication and keeping a record of what is agreed
Following up until the requirement is closed
services.approach: We treat every requirement as a small project: written down, researched, coordinated and reviewed. You make the decisions; we make sure you have what you need to make them.
expect: A written summary of your requirement before work starts
Organised options with the information you asked for
One point of contact and regular updates
Clear notes on what is confirmed and what is still open

faqs.q: Do you guarantee a supplier will be found?
faqs.a: No. We commit to a structured search and honest reporting. If suitable options are limited, we tell you what we found and why.

faqs.q: Who decides which supplier or partner to use?
faqs.a: You do. We present the options and the information behind them; the decision stays with your business.

faqs.q: Which countries do you work with?
faqs.a: We review each requirement individually. Tell us the markets involved and we will confirm whether we can support it.

services.title: Social & Digital Presence
services.summary: Content, creative, video and social media handled as one joined-up piece of work, planned around how your business wants to be seen.
body: A business's online presence is usually built from many small pieces: posts, visuals, videos, captions, replies and the planning behind them. When those pieces are handled separately, the result feels scattered.

We handle them together. Depending on the requirement, that can mean researching and planning content, producing it, editing video, publishing and managing channels, and promoting the work to the right audience.
audience: Businesses that want a consistent, professional presence online
Teams without the time or in-house skills to produce content regularly
Brands launching a product, a campaign or a new channel
handle: Understanding the audience and agreeing a content direction
Planning what is published, where and when
Producing written, visual and video content
Publishing and managing channels where agreed
Reviewing what works and adjusting the plan
services.approach: Content starts from the business, not the platform. We agree what you want to say and to whom, then produce and publish to that plan, reviewing it as we go.
expect: An agreed content direction before production starts
Work produced by people with the relevant skills
A clear approval step before anything is published
Honest reporting on how the work is performing

faqs.q: Do you guarantee followers, reach or sales?
faqs.a: No. We commit to well-planned, professionally produced work and honest reporting. Results depend on the market, the audience and many factors outside anyone's control.

faqs.q: Can you handle only part of it, such as video editing?
faqs.a: Yes. Some clients need one piece of the work, others need all of it. Describe what you need and we will scope it.

faqs.q: Who approves content before it goes live?
faqs.a: You do. Nothing is published on your behalf without the approval process we agree at the start.

services.title: Professional Digital Presence
services.summary: Websites planned, designed, developed and deployed properly, then kept up to date, from the first requirement to a live site.
body: For many businesses, the website is the first place a customer or partner checks. It should be clear, fast, reliable and easy to keep current.

We take a website from requirement to a professionally deployed site: planning what it needs to say, designing and developing it, putting it live, and supporting updates and maintenance afterwards where required.
audience: Businesses without a website, or with one that no longer represents them
Teams that need a site deployed and maintained, not only designed
Businesses that need regular updates to an existing site
handle: Agreeing what the site needs to do and who it is for
Structuring pages and content
Design and development
Deployment to a live domain
Updates, maintenance and technical upkeep where agreed
services.approach: We build for the business, not for a template. The site is planned around what your visitors need to find, built to load quickly and structured so it can be maintained without starting again.
expect: A written scope before design or development starts
Review points before the site goes live
A properly deployed site on your own domain
Clear information on how updates are handled afterwards

faqs.q: Do you only design, or also put the site live?
faqs.a: Both. We can take a site from planning through development to deployment, and support it afterwards where required.

faqs.q: Will the website bring guaranteed business?
faqs.a: No website can guarantee that. We build a clear, professional, well-structured site; what it achieves also depends on your offer, market and promotion.

faqs.q: Can you update a website someone else built?
faqs.a: Often, yes. It depends on how the site was built. Tell us about it and we will review it first.

services.title: Marketing & Growth Support
services.summary: Promotion, audience-focused activity, search visibility and digital optimisation, planned around the audience you actually want to reach.
body: Good work still has to be found. Marketing and growth support is about putting the right message in front of the right people and improving how easily you are found online.
Search visibility, content structure and website optimisation are part of the broader digital support we provide, alongside audience research, targeting and support for online campaigns.
audience: Businesses that want to reach a clearer, better-defined audience
Teams running or planning online promotion
Businesses whose website is hard to find in search
handle: Researching who the audience is and where they are
Planning promotion and campaign activity
Supporting campaigns while they run
Improving search visibility and content structure
Reviewing results and adjusting the approach
services.approach: We start with the audience and the goal, not the tactic. Activity is planned, measured where possible and adjusted based on what the results show.
expect: A clear view of the audience before spend or activity starts
Plain reporting on what was done and what it showed
Recommendations based on results, not assumptions

faqs.a: No. Nobody can honestly guarantee rankings. We improve the things that influence visibility, such as structure, content and technical quality, and report plainly on progress.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee sales or growth?
faqs.a: No. We plan and run promotion carefully and report honestly. Outcomes depend on your offer, market and many other factors.

services.title: Business Solutions
services.summary: Requirement-based support for needs that do not fit a single category, scoped around what your business actually needs.
body: Not every requirement fits a category, and many cross several. Business solutions is how we handle those: we assess the need, identify what expertise it requires, agree a plan and support its execution.
The same principles apply as everywhere else: a written scope, the right people on the work, a clear process and regular communication.
audience: Businesses with a requirement that crosses several areas
Teams that need practical support on an operational problem
Anyone unsure which kind of support fits
handle: Understanding the business need and its constraints
Identifying the expertise the work requires
Agreeing a written scope and plan
Supporting execution against that plan
Reviewing the result, and continuing where ongoing support is needed
services.approach: We scope before we commit. If a requirement is outside what we can do well, we say so early.
expect: An honest assessment of whether we are the right fit
A written scope before work begins
Regular communication throughout

faqs.q: What if my requirement doesn't match any listed service?
faqs.a: That is common. Describe it in the request form and choose "Other / Custom Requirement". We will review it and tell you honestly whether and how we can help.

services.title: Partnerships & Development Projects
services.summary: Supporting NGOs, development organizations, institutions and project partners with sourcing, coordination, supply, digital and operational requirements.
body: Development organizations, institutions and project partners often need a dependable business partner for specific parts of a project: sourcing and supplying goods, coordinating suppliers and deliveries, or handling digital and operational requirements.

MONOHA is a business and service organization, not an NGO. We collaborate with organizations through partnerships and project-based engagements, and our role depends on the requirement, from supply and sourcing support to project coordination, digital execution and other operational services.
audience: NGOs and development organizations with project-based requirements
Institutions managing specific sourcing, supply or operational needs
Project partners looking for a structured implementation and support partner
handle: Understanding the project requirement, specifications and timelines
Sourcing and supply support against agreed specifications
Project coordination with suppliers and other parties involved
Digital and online support connected to the project
Documentation and follow-up in line with the organization's procedures
services.approach: We work within the requirements and procedures of each organization. The scope, specifications and reporting are agreed in writing, and we follow them through to delivery.
expect: A written scope aligned with the project requirement
Delivery against agreed specifications and timelines
Clear documentation and one point of contact
Professional, confidential handling of project information

faqs.a: No. MONOHA SOURCING INTERNATIONAL is a business and service organization. We collaborate with NGOs, development organizations and institutions when their requirements match our capabilities.

faqs.q: How do you work with organizations?
faqs.a: Directly, through partnerships and collaborations, or on project-based assignments. The arrangement depends on the project and the organization's procedures.

faqs.q: Do you share details of past projects?
faqs.a: Only business-level details that the organizations involved have approved. We do not publish confidential project, financial or personal information.
